p.i: The prophecy of Samuel, the Lamanite, to the Nephites.

chapter.li: LEChapter13 Verse1 And now it came to pass in the eighty and sixth year, the Nephites did still remain in wickedness, yea, in great wickedness, while the Lamanites did observe strictly to keep the commandments of God according to the law of Moses. VerseEnd Verse2 And it came to pass that in this year there was one Samuel, a Lamanite, came into the land of Zarahemla and began to preach unto the people. And it came to pass that he did preach many days repentance unto the people, and they did cast him out. And he was about to return to his own land, VerseEnd Verse3 but behold, the voice of the Lord came unto him that he should return again and prophesy unto the people whatsoever things should come into his heart. VerseEnd

Verse4 And it came to pass that they would not suffer that he should enter into the city, therefore he went and got upon the wall thereof, and stretched forth his hand, and cried with a loud voice, and prophesied unto the people whatsoever things the Lord put into his heart. VerseEnd Verse5 And he said unto them, Behold, I, Samuel, a Lamanite, do speak the words of the Lord which he doth put into my heart. And behold, he hath put it into my heart to say unto this people that the sword of justice hangeth over this people. And four hundred years passeth not away save the sword of justice falleth upon this people, VerseEnd Verse6 yea, heavy destruction awaiteth this people, and it surely cometh unto this people. And nothing can save this people, save it be repentance and faith on the Lord Jesus Christ, who surely shall come into the world, and shall suffer many things, and shall be slain for his people. VerseEnd Verse7 And behold, an angel of the Lord hath declared it unto me, and he did bring glad tidings to my soul. And behold, I was sent unto 2PP you to declare it unto 2PP you also, that 2PP ye might have glad tidings; but behold, 2PP ye would not receive me. VerseEnd

Verse8 Therefore, thus saith the Lord: Because of the hardness of the hearts of the people of the Nephites, except they repent, I will take away my word from them, and I will withdraw my spirit from them, and I will suffer them no longer, and I will turn the hearts of their brethren against them, VerseEnd Verse9 and four hundred years shall not pass away before I will cause that they shall be smitten. Yea, I will visit them with the sword, and with famine, and with pestilence; VerseEnd Verse10 yea, I will visit them in my fierce anger. And there shall be those of the fourth generation who shall live, of 2PP your enemies, to behold 2PP your utter destruction. And this shall surely come except 2PP ye repent, saith the Lord, and those of the fourth generation shall visit 2PP your destruction. VerseEnd Verse11 But if 2PP ye will repent and return unto the Lord 2PP your God, I will turn away mine anger, saith the Lord. Yea, thus saith the Lord: Blessed are they who will repent and turn unto me, but woe unto him that repenteth not. VerseEnd Verse12 Yea, woe unto this great city of Zarahemla, for behold, it is because of those who are righteous that it is saved. Yea, woe unto this great city, for I perceive, saith the Lord, that there are many, yea, even the more part of this great city, that will harden their hearts against me, saith the Lord. VerseEnd Verse13 But blessed are they who will repent, for them will I spare. But behold, if it were not for the righteous who are in this great city, behold, I would cause that fire should come down out of heaven and destroy it. VerseEnd Verse14 But behold, it is for the righteous’ sake that it is spared. But behold, the time cometh, saith the Lord, that when 2PP ye shall cast out the righteous from among 2PP you, then shall 2PP ye be ripe for destruction.

Yea, woe be unto this great city because of the wickedness and abominations which are in her; VerseEnd Verse15 yea, and woe be unto the city of Gideon for the wickedness and abominations which are in her; VerseEnd Verse16 yea, and woe be unto all the cities which are in the land round about, which are possessed by the Nephites, because of the wickedness and the abominations which is in them. VerseEnd Verse17 And behold, a curse shall come upon the land, saith the Lord of Hosts, because of the people’s sake who are upon the land, yea, because of their wickedness and their abominations. VerseEnd

Verse18 And it shall come to pass, saith the Lord of Hosts, yea, our great and true God, that whoso shall hide up treasures in the earth shall find them again no more, because of the great curse of the land, save he be a righteous man and shall hide it up unto the Lord; VerseEnd Verse19 for I will, saith the Lord, that they shall hide up their treasures unto me. And cursed be they who hide not up their treasures unto me, for none hideth up their treasures unto me save it be the righteous. And he that hideth not up his treasure unto me, cursed is he, and also the treasure; and none shall redeem it because of the curse of the land. VerseEnd Verse20 And the day shall come that they shall hide up their treasures because they have set their hearts upon riches. And because they have set their hearts upon their riches and will hide up their treasures when they shall flee before their enemies, because they will not hide them up unto me, cursed be they and also their treasures; and in that day shall they be smitten, saith the Lord. VerseEnd

Verse21 Behold 2PP ye, the people of this great city, and hearken unto my words, yea, hearken unto the words which the Lord saith. For behold, he saith that 2PP ye are cursed because of 2PP your riches, and also are 2PP your riches cursed, because 2PP ye have set 2PP your hearts upon them and have not hearkened unto the words of him who gave them unto 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse22 2PP Ye do not remember the Lord 2PP your God in the things which he hath blessed 2PP you, but 2PP ye do always remember 2PP your riches — not to thank the Lord 2PP your God for them. Yea, 2PP your heart is not drawn out unto the Lord, but they do swell with great pride unto boasting, and unto great swelling, envyings, strifes, malice, persecutions, and murders, and all manner of iniquities. VerseEnd Verse23 For this cause hath the Lord God caused that a curse should come upon the land, and also upon 2PP your riches, and this because of 2PP your iniquities. VerseEnd Verse24 Yea, woe unto this people because of this time which has arrived that 2PP ye do cast out the prophets, and do mock them, and cast stones at them, and do slay them, and do do all manner of iniquity unto them, even as they did of old time. VerseEnd

Verse25 And now when 2PP ye talk, 2PP ye say, If our days had been in the days of our fathers of old, 2PP ye would not have slain the prophets, 2PP ye would not have stoned them and cast them out. VerseEnd Verse26 Behold, 2PP ye are worse than they; for, as the Lord liveth, if a prophet come among 2PP you and declareth unto 2PP you the word of the Lord, which testifieth of 2PP your sins and iniquities, 2PP ye are angry with him, and cast him out, and seek all manner of ways to destroy him. Yea, 2PP you will say that he is a false prophet, and that he is a sinner and of the Devil, because he testifieth that 2PP your deeds are evil. VerseEnd Verse27 But behold, if a man shall come among 2PP you and shall say, Do this and there is no iniquity, do that and 2PP ye shall not suffer — yea, he will say, Walk after the pride of 2PP your own hearts, yea, walk after the pride of 2PP your eyes and do whatsoever 2PP your heart desireth — and if a man shall come among 2PP you and say this, 2PP ye will receive him and 2PP ye will say that he is a prophet. VerseEnd Verse28 Yea, 2PP ye will lift him up and 2PP ye will give unto him of 2PP your substance, 2PP ye will give unto him of 2PP your gold and of 2PP your silver, and 2PP ye will clothe him with costly apparel. And because he speaketh flattering words unto 2PP you and he saith that all is well, and then 2PP ye will not find no fault with him. VerseEnd

Verse29 O 2PP ye wicked and 2PP ye perverse generation, 2PP ye hardened and 2PP ye stiffnecked people, how long will 2PP ye suppose that the Lord will suffer 2PP you? Yea, how long will 2PP ye suffer yourselves to be led by foolish and blind guides? Yea, how long will 2PP ye choose darkness rather than light? VerseEnd Verse30 Yea, behold, the anger of the Lord is already kindled against 2PP you. Behold, he hath cursed the land because of 2PP your iniquity; VerseEnd Verse31 and behold, the time cometh that he curseth 2PP your riches, that it becometh slippery, that 2PP ye cannot hold them. And in the days of 2PP your poverty 2PP ye cannot retain them, VerseEnd Verse32 and in the days of 2PP your poverty 2PP ye shall cry unto the Lord; and in vain shall 2PP ye cry, for 2PP your desolation is already come upon 2PP you and 2PP your destruction is made sure. And then shall 2PP ye weep and howl in that day, saith the Lord of Hosts. And then shall 2PP ye lament and say, VerseEnd Verse33 Oh that I had repented and had not killed the prophets, and stoned them, and cast them out. Yea, in that day shall 2PP ye say, Oh that we had remembered the Lord our God in the day that he gave us our riches, and then they would not have become slippery, that we should lose them; for behold, our riches are gone from us. VerseEnd Verse34 Behold, we lay a tool here and on the morrow it is gone. And behold, our swords are taken from us in the day we have sought them for battle. VerseEnd Verse35 Yea, we have hid up our treasures and they have slipped away from us because of the curse of the land. VerseEnd Verse36 Oh that we had repented in the day that the word of the Lord came unto us, for behold, the land is cursed, and all things have become slippery and we cannot hold them. VerseEnd Verse37 Behold, we are surrounded by demons, yea, we are encircled about by the angels of him who hath sought to destroy our souls. Behold, our iniquities are great. O Lord, canst 2PSI thou not turn away 2PSI thine anger from us? And this shall be 2PP your language in these days. VerseEnd

Verse38 But behold, 2PP your days of probation are past. 2PP Ye have procrastinated the day of 2PP your salvation until it is everlastingly too late and 2PP your destruction is made sure; yea, for 2PP ye have sought all the days of 2PP your lives for that which 2PP ye could not obtain, and 2PP ye have sought for happiness in doing iniquity, which thing is contrary to the nature of that righteousness which is in our great and eternal Head. VerseEnd Verse39 O 2PP ye people of the land, that 2PP ye would hear my words. And I pray that the anger of the Lord be turned away from 2PP you and that 2PP ye would repent and be saved. VerseEnd

LEChapter14 Verse1 And now it came to pass that Samuel, the Lamanite, did prophesy a great many more things which cannot be written. VerseEnd Verse2 And behold, he said unto them, Behold, I give unto 2PP you a sign; for five years more cometh, and behold, then cometh the Son of God to redeem all those who shall believe on his name. VerseEnd Verse3 And behold, this will I give unto 2PP you for a sign at the time of his coming: for behold, there shall be great lights in heaven, insomuch that in the night before he cometh there shall be no darkness, insomuch that it shall appear unto man as if it was day. VerseEnd Verse4 Therefore, there shall be one day and a night and a day, as if it were one day and there were no night; and this shall be unto 2PP you for a sign. For 2PP ye shall know of the rising of the sun, and also of its sitting, therefore they shall know of a surety that there shall be two days and a night. Nevertheless, the night shall not be darkened, and it shall be the night before he is born. VerseEnd Verse5 And behold, there shall be a new star arise, such an one as 2PP ye never have beheld, and this also shall be a sign unto 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse6 And behold, this is not all; there shall be many signs and wonders in heaven. VerseEnd Verse7 And it shall come to pass that 2PP ye shall all be amazed and wonder, insomuch that 2PP ye shall fall to the earth. VerseEnd Verse8 And it shall come to pass that whosoever shall believe on the Son of God, the same shall have everlasting life. VerseEnd

Verse9 And behold, thus hath the Lord commanded me by his angel that I should come and tell this thing unto 2PP you, yea, he hath commanded that I should prophesy these things unto 2PP you. Yea, he hath said unto me, Cry unto this people, Repent and prepare the way of the Lord. VerseEnd Verse10 And now because I am a Lamanite, and have spoken unto 2PP you the words which the Lord hath commanded me, and because it was hard against 2PP you, 2PP ye are angry with me, and do seek to destroy me and have cast me out from among 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse11 And 2PP ye shall hear my words, for, for this intent have I come up upon the walls of this city, that 2PP ye might hear and know of the judgments of God which do await 2PP you because of 2PP your iniquities, and also that 2PP ye might know the conditions of repentance, VerseEnd Verse12 and also that 2PP ye might know of the coming of Jesus Christ, the Son of God the Father of Heaven and of earth, the Creator of all things from the beginning, and that 2PP ye might know of the signs of his coming, to the intent that 2PP ye might believe on his name. VerseEnd Verse13 And if 2PP ye believe on his name, 2PP ye will repent of all 2PP your sins, that thereby 2PP ye may have a remission of them through his merits. VerseEnd

Verse14 And behold again, another sign I give unto 2PP you, yea, a sign of his death; VerseEnd Verse15 for behold, he surely must die, that salvation may come. Yea, it behooveth him and becometh expedient that he dieth to bring to pass the resurrection of the dead, that thereby men may be brought into the presence of the Lord. VerseEnd Verse16 Yea, behold, this death bringeth to pass the resurrection and redeemeth all mankind from the first death (that spiritual death); for all mankind, by the Fall of Adam, being cut off from the presence of the Lord, are considered as dead, both as to things temporal and to things spiritual. VerseEnd Verse17 But behold, the resurrection of Christ redeemeth mankind, yea, even all mankind, and bringeth them back into the presence of the Lord. VerseEnd Verse18 Yea, and it bringeth to pass the conditions of repentance — that whosoever repenteth, the same is not hewn down and cast into the fire, but whosoever repenteth not is hewn down and cast into the fire, and there cometh upon them again a spiritual death, yea, a second death, for they are cut off again as to things pertaining to righteousness. VerseEnd Verse19 Therefore, repent 2PP ye, repent 2PP ye, lest by knowing these things and not doing them 2PP ye shall suffer yourselves to come under condemnation, and 2PP ye are brought down unto this second death. VerseEnd

Verse20 But behold, as I said unto 2PP you concerning another sign, a sign of his death, behold, in that day that he shall suffer death, the sun shall be darkened and refuse to give his light unto 2PP you, and also the moon and the stars. And there shall be no light upon the face of this land, even from the time that he shall suffer death, for the space of three days, to the time that he shall rise again from the dead. VerseEnd Verse21 Yea, at the time that he shall yield up the ghost, there shall be thunderings and lightnings for the space of many hours, and the earth shall shake and tremble, and the rocks which are upon the face of this earth, which are both above the earth and beneath, which 2PP ye know at this time are solid (or the more part of it is one solid mass) shall be broken up, VerseEnd Verse22 yea, they shall be rent in twain, and shall ever after be found in seams, and in cracks, and in broken fragments, upon the face of the whole earth, yea, both above the earth and beneath. VerseEnd Verse23 And behold, there shall be great tempests, and there shall be many mountains laid low like unto a valley, and there shall be many places which are now called valleys which shall become mountains, whose heighth thereof is great. VerseEnd Verse24 And many highways shall be broken up, and many cities shall become desolate, VerseEnd Verse25 and many graves shall be opened and shall yield up many of their dead, and many saints shall appear unto many. VerseEnd Verse26 And behold, thus hath the angel spoken unto me, for he said unto me that there should be thunderings and lightnings for the space of many hours; VerseEnd Verse27 and he said unto me that while the thunder and the lightning lasted, and the tempest, that these things should be, and that darkness should cover the face of the whole earth for the space of three days. VerseEnd Verse28 And the angel said unto me that many shall see greater things than these, to the intent that they might believe; that these signs and these wonders should come to pass upon all the face of this land, to the intent that there should be no cause for unbelief among the children of men — VerseEnd Verse29 and this to the intent that whosoever will believe might be saved, and that whosoever will not believe, a righteous judgment might come upon them. And also, if they are condemned, they bring upon themselves their own condemnation. VerseEnd

Verse30 And now remember, remember, my brethren, that whosoever perisheth, perisheth unto himself, and whosoever doeth iniquity, doeth it unto himself. For behold, 2PP ye are free; 2PP ye are permitted to act for yourselves. For behold, God hath given unto 2PP you a knowledge, and he hath made 2PP you free. VerseEnd Verse31 He hath given unto 2PP you that 2PP ye might know good from evil, and he hath given unto 2PP you that 2PP ye might choose life or death. And 2PP ye can do good and be restored unto that which is good, or have that which is good restored unto 2PP you; or 2PP ye can do evil and have that which is evil restored unto 2PP you. VerseEnd LEChapter15 Verse1 And now my beloved brethren, behold, I declare unto 2PP you that except 2PP ye shall repent, 2PP your houses shall be left unto 2PP you desolate. VerseEnd Verse2 Yea, except 2PP ye repent, 2PP your women shall have great cause to mourn in the day that they shall give suck; for 2PP ye shall attempt to flee and there shall be no place for refuge. Yea, and woe unto them which are with child, for they shall be heavy and cannot flee; therefore, they shall be trodden down and shall be left to perish. VerseEnd Verse3 Yea, woe unto this people who are called the people of Nephi, except they shall repent when they shall see all those signs and wonders which shall be shewed unto them; for behold, they have been a chosen people of the Lord. Yea, the people of Nephi hath he loved, and also hath he chastened them, yea, in the days of their iniquities hath he chastened them because he loveth them. VerseEnd

Verse4 But behold, my brethren, the Lamanites hath he hated because their deeds have been evil continually, and this because of the iniquity of the tradition of their fathers. But behold, salvation hath come unto them through the preaching of the Nephites, and for this intent hath the Lord prolonged their days. VerseEnd Verse5 And I would that 2PP ye should behold that the more part of them are in the path of their duty, and they do walk circumspectly before God, and they do observe to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, according to the law of Moses. VerseEnd Verse6 Yea, I say unto 2PP you that the more part of them are doing this, and they are striving, with unwearied diligence, that they may bring the remainder of their brethren to the knowledge of the truth; therefore, there are many who do add to their numbers daily. VerseEnd Verse7 And behold, 2PP ye do know of yourselves, for 2PP ye have witnessed it, that as many of them as are brought to the knowledge of the truth, and to know of the wicked and abominable traditions of their fathers, and are led to believe the holy scriptures — yea, the prophecies of the holy prophets which are written, which leadeth them to faith on the Lord and unto repentance, which faith and repentance bringeth a change of heart unto them — VerseEnd Verse8 therefore, as many as have come to this, 2PP ye know of yourselves, are firm and steadfast in the faith, and in the thing wherewith they have been made free. VerseEnd Verse9 And 2PP ye know also that they have buried their weapons of war, and they fear to take them up lest by any means they shall sin. Yea, 2PP ye can see that they fear to sin, for behold, they will suffer themselves that they be trodden down and slain by their enemies, and will not lift their swords against them, and this because of their faith in Christ. VerseEnd

Verse10 And now because of their steadfastness when they do believe in that thing which they do believe, for because of their firmness when they are once enlightened, behold, the Lord shall bless them and prolong their days, notwithstanding their iniquity. VerseEnd Verse11 Yea, even if they should dwindle in unbelief, the Lord shall prolong their days until the time shall come which hath been spoken of by our fathers, and also by the prophet Zenos, and many other prophets, concerning the restoration of our brethren the Lamanites again to the knowledge of the truth. VerseEnd Verse12 Yea, I say unto 2PP you that in the latter times, the promises of the Lord hath been extended to our brethren, the Lamanites; and notwithstanding the many afflictions which they shall have, and notwithstanding they shall be driven to and fro upon the face of the earth, and be hunted, and shall be smitten and scattered abroad, having no place for refuge, the Lord shall be merciful unto them, VerseEnd Verse13 and this is according to the prophecy that they shall again be brought to the true knowledge, which is the knowledge of their Redeemer, and their great and their true Shepherd, and be numbered among his sheep. VerseEnd Verse14 Therefore, I say unto 2PP you, it shall be better for them than for 2PP you, except 2PP ye repent. VerseEnd Verse15 For behold, had the mighty works been shewn unto them which have been shewn unto 2PP you, yea, unto them who have dwindled in unbelief because of the traditions of their fathers, 2PP ye can see of yourselves that they never would again have dwindled in unbelief. VerseEnd Verse16 Therefore, saith the Lord, I will not utterly destroy them, but I will cause that in the day of my wisdom they shall return again unto me, saith the Lord. VerseEnd Verse17 And now behold, saith the Lord, concerning the people of the Nephites, if they will not repent and observe to do my will, I will utterly destroy them, saith the Lord, because of their unbelief, notwithstanding the many mighty works which I have done among them. And as surely as the Lord liveth shall these things be, saith the Lord. VerseEnd

LEChapter16 Verse1 And now it came to pass that there were many who heard the words of Samuel, the Lamanite, which he spake upon the walls of the city. And as many as believed on his words went forth and sought for Nephi; and when they had came forth and found him, they confessed unto him their sins and denied not, desiring that they might be baptized unto the Lord. VerseEnd Verse2 But as many as there were who did not believe in the words of Samuel were angry with him, and they cast stones at him upon the wall, and also many shot arrows at him as he stood upon the wall. But the spirit of the Lord was with him, insomuch that they could not hit him with their stones, neither with their arrows. VerseEnd

Verse3 Now when they saw this, that they could not hit him, there were many more who did believe on his words, insomuch that they went away unto Nephi to be baptized. VerseEnd Verse4 For behold, Nephi was baptizing, and a prophesying, and preaching, crying repentance unto the people, shewing signs and wonders, working miracles among the people, that they might know that the Christ must shortly come, VerseEnd Verse5 telling them of things which must shortly come, that they might know and remember at the time of their coming that they had been made known unto them beforehand, to the intent that they might believe. Therefore, as many as believed on the words of Samuel went forth unto him to be baptized, for they came repenting and confessing their sins. VerseEnd

Verse6 But the more part of them did not believe in the words of Samuel; therefore, when they saw that they could not hit him with their stones and their arrows, they cried out unto their captains, saying, Take this fellow and bind him, for behold, he hath a devil! And because of the power of the devil which is in him, we cannot hit him with our stones and our arrows; therefore take him, and bind him, and away with him! VerseEnd Verse7 And as they went forth to lay their hands on him, behold, he did cast himself down from the wall and did flee out of their lands, yea, even unto his own country, and began to preach and to prophesy among his own people. VerseEnd Verse8 And behold, he was never heard of more among the Nephites; and thus were the affairs of the people. VerseEnd Verse9 And thus ended the eighty and sixth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi. VerseEnd Verse10 And thus ended also the eighty and seventh year of the reign of the judges, and the more part of the people remaining in their pride and wickedness, and the lesser part walking more circumspectly before God. VerseEnd Verse11 And thus were the conditions also in the eighty and eighth year of the reign of the judges. VerseEnd Verse12 And there was but little alteration in the affairs of the people, save it were the people began to be more hardened in iniquity, and do more and more of that which was contrary to the commandments of God in the eighty and ninth year of the reign of the judges. VerseEnd

Verse13 But behold, it came to pass in the ninetieth year of the reign of the judges, there were great signs given unto the people, and wonders; and the words of the prophets began to be fulfilled, VerseEnd Verse14 and angels did appear unto men — wise men — and did declare unto them glad tidings of great joy; and thus in this year, the scriptures began to be fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse15 Nevertheless, the people began to harden their hearts — all save it were the most believing part of them, both of the Nephites and also of the Lamanites — and began to depend upon their own strength and upon their own wisdom, saying, VerseEnd Verse16 Some things they may have guessed right among so many, but behold, we know that all these great and marvelous works cannot come to pass of which hath been spoken. VerseEnd Verse17 And they began to reason and to contend among themselves, saying VerseEnd Verse18 that it is not reasonable that such a being as a christ shall come. If so, and he be the Son of God the Father of Heaven and of earth, as it has been spoken, why will he not shew himself unto us as well as unto them who shall be at Jerusalem? VerseEnd Verse19 Yea, why will he not shew himself in this land as well as in the land of Jerusalem? VerseEnd Verse20 But behold, we know that this is a wicked tradition which has been handed down unto us by our fathers, to cause us that we should believe in some great and marvelous thing which should come to pass, but not among us, but in a land which is far distant, a land which we know not; therefore, they can keep us in ignorance, for we cannot witness with our own eyes that they are true. VerseEnd Verse21 And they will, by the cunning and the mysterious arts of the Evil One, work some great mystery which we cannot understand, which will keep us down to be servants to their words, and also servants unto them (for we depend upon them to teach us the word), and thus will they keep us in ignorance if we will yield ourselves unto them all the days of our lives. VerseEnd

Verse22 And many more things did the people imagine up in their hearts which were foolish and vain; and they were much disturbed, for Satan did stir them up to do iniquity continually. Yea, he did go about spreading rumors and contentions upon all the face of the land, that he might harden the hearts of the people against that which was good and against that which should come. VerseEnd Verse23 And notwithstanding the signs and the wonders which were wrought among the people of the Lord, and the many miracles which they did, Satan did get great hold upon the hearts of the people upon all the face of the land. VerseEnd Verse24 And thus ended the ninetieth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi. VerseEnd Verse25 And thus ended The Book of Helaman, according to the record of Helaman and his sons. VerseEnd
